## holt 0.4.3 — complete stable-tag proof denominator

Install the signed, version-pinned GitHub release artifact:

```bash
npm install -g https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/releases/download/v0.4.3/holt.tgz
```

The bare `holt` npm registry name is not an official distribution. Do not use
`npm install -g holt`; use the exact GitHub release URL.

This patch keeps the 0.4.2 product bytes and makes the stable-tag quality lane install the same
pinned browser-proof dependency already required by PR CI. The complete TUI/graph denominator can
therefore run instead of being silently skipped; this is release-process evidence, not evidence of
customer adoption, productivity gains, universal host enforcement, or a commercial service.

### Verify this exact artifact

After downloading `holt.tgz` and the release assets:

```bash
gh release verify v0.4.3 --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh release verify-asset v0.4.3 holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh attestation verify holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
holt audit --require-signature
```

Each command verifies a different boundary. Do not infer provenance if the attestation query does
not succeed.

For the full change ledger and remaining gaps, see the
[post-v0.3.1 55-commit audit](https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/blob/v0.4.3/docs/research/2026-08-13-post-v0.3.1-55-commit-audit.md).
